critical before bituminous layer placement Download ExcelDownload PDF **25** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per course placement cycle; continuous throughout construction QC Engineer, Site Engineer [IS 2386:1963](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2386-Part-1-1963) [SP 20:2002](https://infralens.in/code/IS-20-2002) [IS 2720:1973](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2720-Part-2-1973) Related [📐IS 2386](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2386) [✏️Max Aggregate Size By Member](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/max-aggregate-size-by-member) [📘Aggregate Grading (IS 383)](https://infralens.in/handbook/aggregate-grading) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. AGGREGATE MATERIAL QUALITY | | A1 | Aggregate source approved; quarry documentation and test certificates available
Acceptance: Source test report dated <12 months; all test parameters within spec | Cl. 401 — Material approval | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Coarse aggregate Los Angeles Abrasion (LAA) value ≤ 40%
Acceptance: LAA ≤ 40% for WBM/WMM; tested per IS 2386 Part IV; 1 test per 1000 tonnes | Cl. 401 — Durability requirement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Impact value of coarse aggregate ≤ 30% (for WBM)
Acceptance: Impact value ≤ 30% for WBM; measured per IS 2386 Part IV | Cl. 401 — Strength requirement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | Aggregate grading complies with specification (sieve analysis results)
Acceptance: Sieve analysis within ±5% of spec limits for each sieve; 1 test per 500 tonnes | Cl. 401 — Grading compliance | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A5 | Fines material (<75 micron) ≤ 10% for WBM/WMM; PI of fines 4-9
Acceptance: Fines ≤ 10% by dry weight; PI 4-9 (determined per IS 2720); non-plastic fines acceptable | Cl. 401 — Fines control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A6 | Elongated & flaky aggregate particles ≤ 25% (for WBM)
Acceptance: E&F ≤ 25%; measured per IS 2386 Part I; manual sieving method | Cl. 401 — Shape control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. MATERIAL DELIVERY & STOCKPILING | | B1 | Aggregate delivered per approved material schedule; source batch identity maintained
Acceptance: Delivery note includes source, date, test cert; segregation by lot maintained | Cl. 401 — Material traceability | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Stockpiles separated by size fraction; no intermingling of material
Acceptance: Clear separation between coarse & fines stockpiles; covered to prevent contamination | Cl. 401 — Segregation control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Stockpile surface compacted and protected from surface water infiltration
Acceptance: No pooled water; top layer compacted; covered during heavy rain | Cl. 401 — Moisture control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Material moisture content ≤ 2% above OMC at time of placement
Acceptance: Measured moisture ≤ (OMC + 2%); tested daily or before compaction | Cl. 401 — Moisture at placement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. LAYING & SPREADING | | C1 | Subgrade inspected and approved before course material is spread
Acceptance: Subgrade approval sign-off available; surface cleaned of debris | Cl. 401 — Prerequisite approval | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Material spread uniformly in single layer of specified thickness (150-200mm)
Acceptance: Layer thickness: 150-200mm ±10mm; measured at 50m intervals; 4-5 cross-sections per km | Cl. 401 — Thickness control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Spreader equipment maintains uniform depth across full width; roller behind spreader
Acceptance: Spreader hopper empty before reversing; no segregation visible at edges | Cl. 401 — Equipment efficiency | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Material bond breaker (dry stone dust or sand) applied if required for WMM/GSB
Acceptance: Sand/dust layer 3-5mm; uniform distribution; prevents bonding to subgrade | Cl. 401 — Interface treatment | OK
NC
